name: visual_inspect
description: Inspect document visually with 2D spatial layout telemetry (ASCII wireframe, page breakdown, margins, defects) and optional headless rendered images (withVisual: true; add outputDir to write them to a folder inside the allowed directories, for example next to the document, instead of the server temp folder). Renders the in-memory session state (includes unsaved execute_batch edits, not the last saved file); success returns {ok:true,sessionId,revision,dirty,telemetry,...} (dirty:true = unsaved edits present).
